stories.title: Saudi Defense Minister Invites UAE Vice President Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed to Visit Kingdom

en.title: Saudi Defense Minister Invites UAE Vice President Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed to Visit Kingdom
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Defense Minister Prince Khalid bin Salman has invited UAE Vice President Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed Al-Nahyan to visit the kingdom.

stories.title: Pope Says Concerns About AI ‘Should Be Taken Seriously’

en.title: Pope Says Concerns About AI 'Should Be Taken Seriously'
en.summary: The Pope has stated that concerns about artificial intelligence should be treated with seriousness and not dismissed.

stories.title: Pope Leo says concerns about AI doom scenarios are not ‘fake news’

en.title: Pope Leo says concerns about AI doom scenarios are not 'fake news'
en.summary: The Pope has emphasized that concerns about artificial intelligence potentially causing global harm are legitimate and should not be dismissed. He criticized technology leaders who oppose AI regulation.

stories.title: Saudi defense minister invites UAE VP to Kingdom on Tuesday

en.title: Saudi defense minister invites UAE VP to Kingdom on Tuesday
en.summary: Saudi Defense Minister Prince Khalid bin Salman has invited UAE Vice President Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed Al-Nahyan to visit Saudi Arabia on Tuesday, with the visit confirmed by Emirates News Agency.

stories.title: Riyadh to host global WPC Energy Congress in October

en.title: Riyadh to host global WPC Energy Congress in October
en.summary: Saudi Arabia will host the 25th World Petroleum Congress from October 11-15 in Riyadh, the first time the event is held in the Kingdom. The conference will gather energy ministers, industry executives and policymakers to discuss energy security and future pathways.

stories.title: Saudi camel trading rules protect buyers, animals

en.title: Saudi camel trading rules protect buyers, animals
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture approved nationwide camel trading rules to protect buyers and owners while promoting animal welfare. The rules establish requirements for sales, leasing, exchanges, ownership records, and animal health standards.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia condemns Israeli officials, settlers for storming Al-Aqsa Mosque

en.title: Saudi Arabia condemns Israeli officials, settlers for storming Al-Aqsa Mosque
en.summary: Saudi Arabia condemned Israeli officials and settlers for what it described as provocative practices at Al-Aqsa Mosque, following an incident where Israeli authorities closed one gate after 1,731 settlers entered the compound.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia strongly condemns continued Israeli provocative actions against Al-Aqsa Mosque

en.title: Saudi Arabia strongly condemns continued Israeli provocative actions against Al-Aqsa Mosque
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Foreign Affairs strongly condemned Israeli provocative actions and extremist settler activities at Al-Aqsa Mosque, rejecting what it characterized as violations of international law.

stories.title: Saudi foreign minister arrives in Washington for official visit

en.title: Saudi foreign minister arrives in Washington for official visit
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan has arrived in Washington for official discussions with U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio. The visit will cover bilateral relations and current regional and international matters.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia condemns terrorist attack on security checkpoint in Pakistan

en.title: Saudi Arabia condemns terrorist attack on security checkpoint in Pakistan
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Foreign Affairs issued a statement strongly condemning a terrorist attack on a security checkpoint in Pakistan's Dera Ismail Khan region that resulted in multiple fatalities. The Kingdom expressed solidarity with Pakistan and reaffirmed its opposition to all forms of terrorism and extremism.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia Condemns Terrorist Attack in Dera Ismail Khan, Reaffirms Support for Pakistan

en.title: Saudi Arabia Condemns Terrorist Attack in Dera Ismail Khan, Reaffirms Support for Pakistan
en.summary: Saudi Arabia condemned a terrorist attack targeting a security checkpoint in Dera Ismail Khan in northwestern Pakistan that resulted in casualties. The country reaffirmed its support for Pakistan.

stories.title: ‘Any attack on Saudi Arabia is an attack on Morocco,’ King Mohammed VI says

en.title: 'Any attack on Saudi Arabia is an attack on Morocco,' King Mohammed VI says
en.summary: Morocco's King Mohammed VI expressed solidarity with Saudi Arabia, stating that attacks on the Kingdom are attacks on Morocco. He condemned Houthi strikes against the country and reaffirmed Morocco's support for Saudi security.

stories.title: ‎Build Station CEO says dividends exclude post-IPO profits

en.title: Build Station CEO says dividends exclude post-IPO profits
en.summary: Build Station's CEO stated that dividends distributed to shareholders come only from pre-IPO retained earnings of SAR 183 million, with approximately SAR 120 million paid out representing 65% of those reserves.

stories.title: ‎Rou'a Al Haram, MRCB mull SAR 21B development in Makkah

en.title: Rou'a Al Haram, MRCB mull SAR 21B development in Makkah
en.summary: Rou'a Al Haram and Malaysia's MRCB have signed an agreement to study a SAR 21 billion mixed-use development within Makkah's King Salman Gate project, including residential, commercial and transportation facilities.

stories.title: ‎INEOS halts Europe’s last 3 major acetyls plants as gas prices soar

en.title: INEOS halts Europe's last 3 major acetyls plants as gas prices soar
en.summary: INEOS suspended operations at three chemical plants in Britain after European gas prices rose to approximately 12 times higher than U.S. levels, making the facilities economically unviable. These are Europe's last remaining large-scale industrial acetyls production units.

stories.title: ‎Industry Ministry issues 364 licenses worth SAR 4.5B in June

en.title: Industry Ministry issues 364 licenses worth SAR 4.5B in June
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources issued 364 new industrial licenses in June worth approximately SAR 4.46 billion, with 164 factories beginning production. The projects are expected to generate over 3,138 job opportunities across the Kingdom.

en.title: Tadawul announces Q3 2026 index maintenance
en.summary: The Saudi Exchange announced updates to free-float shares for listed companies effective October 4. Several companies including Chemanol, Armah Sports, Ladun Investment, and Amwaj International were added to various indices on the Main Market and Nomu-Parallel Market.
